mission: Separate legitimate fresh source-network recovery from missing-artwork identity quarantine

impacts.reason: A fresh controlled product validation may establish network recovery while preserving an individual missing-artwork identity quarantine. Original failed validation cannot unpause; no price/check state is advanced. Required denials revoke permission and no retry chain is admitted.

routes: Existing scheduled SNKRDUNK due-work consumer; explicit source-recovery network-repair scope only
dependencies: Original retained denial, current product snapshot lineage, request ordinals, source singleton, settlement and existing identity guards
impact.deployment_impact: Staging API and SNKRDUNK collector code only; no commands, cadence, budgets, concurrency or sessions changed.

recovery.procedure: Restore prior collector/API revision; contain pending repair if unattempted. Any required denial re-pauses normal admission. Retain snapshots and individual quarantine.
recovery.trigger: Required source denial, mismatched lineage, unsettled request accounting or unexpected identity/price mutation
recovery.backup: No schema or price-history rewrite; retained original and fresh evidence stay immutable.

verification.observation_window: After verified delivery authorize at most one fresh metered repair of work 2543, observe natural scheduled consumer, then subsequent bounded RAW captures/no-listings. If required source denial occurs retain pause; no second repair.
